description: Welcome to this beautiful split-level floor plan townhome in the heart of Encino, offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and more than 1,900 square feet of inviting living space. Thoughtfully designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, this light-filled residence features a spacious living room complete with a cozy fireplace and stylish wet bar. The tastefully updated kitchen is appointed with elegant granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, creating the perfect setting for cooking and gathering. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite boasts high ceilings, a walk-in closet, and a private balcony—ideal for peaceful mornings or relaxing evenings. The spa-inspired primary bathroom features elegant countertops, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. Additional highlights include ceiling fans in every bedroom, an in-unit laundry closet, central air and heat, a private front patio for outdoor enjoyment, and a direct-access 2-car attached garage. Ideally located near the 101 freeway and Ventura Blvd which offers convenient access to premier shopping, dining, and entertainment.
